# Story 12.1: Unit tests asserting zero skipped tests across the suite (red-phase)

Status: done

## Story

As a developer,
I want a red-phase test that scans every spec file in all four projects and fails if any skipped test (`.skip`, `xit`, `xdescribe`) is present,
so that Story 12.2 has a defined, executable contract to make pass when it enables or removes each skip.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A new spec scans all `*.spec.ts` files under `apps/server`, `apps/dms-material`, `apps/dms-material-e2e`, and `apps/electron` for skipped-test markers (`.skip(`, `xit(`, `xdescribe(`) and fails (red), reporting each file:line that still contains a skip. It fails today because the current baseline is non-empty — server: `yahoo-finance2-version.spec.ts`, `database-performance-integration.spec.ts` (4 skips), `indexes-sold-trades.spec.ts`, `indexes-open-trades.spec.ts`; dms-material: `primeng-removal.spec.ts`, `symbol-search.service.spec.ts` (2), `base-table.component.spec.ts` (3), `file-upload-validation.spec.ts` (8), `open-positions.component.spec.ts`; e2e: `volatility-visibility.spec.ts`, `universe-table-workflows.spec.ts` (~14), `symbol-filter-header.spec.ts` (4).
2. The same scan logic, when pointed at a directory tree containing no skipped tests, passes — so the assertion can be re-run after Story 12.2 to confirm zero skips remain (green).
3. The new "no skipped tests" assertion is written into a spec file and marked `.skip()` (`it.skip`) so CI stays green while skips still exist; every pre-existing test remains unskipped and green.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [x] Task 1: Implement the skip-scanner (AC: #1, #2)
  - [x] 1.1 Add a spec (e.g. `apps/dms-material/src/app/shared/no-skipped-tests.spec.ts`, or a dedicated location that can reach all four project trees from the repo root) that walks `apps/{server,dms-material,dms-material-e2e,electron}` for `*.spec.ts` files and collects every line matching `.skip(`, `xit(`, or `xdescribe(`.
  - [x] 1.2 Assert the collected list is empty; on failure, report each offending `file:line`. This assertion fails (red) today because the baseline in AC #1 is non-empty.
- [x] Task 2: Prove the scanner passes on a clean tree (AC: #2)
  - [x] 2.1 Add an unskipped unit test that runs the same scan logic against a small fixture directory containing no skips and asserts it returns zero hits — proving the scanner itself is correct and will go green once Story 12.2 clears the real baseline.
- [x] Task 3: Mark the red-phase assertion skipped (AC: #3)
  - [x] 3.1 Mark the AC #1 "no skips in the repo" assertion `.skip()` so CI stays green while skips still exist; leave the AC #2 fixture test unskipped and green.

## Dev Notes

- **Why a scanner spec:** the Epic's concrete, verifiable change is "zero skipped tests remain." A single executable assertion over all four project trees is that contract. Story 12.2 makes it pass by enabling or removing each skip; this story only defines the failing check.
- **Baseline (verified on disk):** server — `yahoo-finance2-version.spec.ts`, `database-performance-integration.spec.ts` (4), `indexes-sold-trades.spec.ts`, `indexes-open-trades.spec.ts`; dms-material — `primeng-removal.spec.ts`, `symbol-search.service.spec.ts` (2), `base-table.component.spec.ts` (3), `file-upload-validation.spec.ts` (8), `open-positions.component.spec.ts`; e2e — `volatility-visibility.spec.ts`, `universe-table-workflows.spec.ts` (~14), `symbol-filter-header.spec.ts` (4). Re-run the scan to get exact counts before Story 12.2; treat this list as a starting inventory, not an exhaustive guarantee.
- **Red-phase TDD convention:** AC #1's assertion is written `.skip()` so CI stays green now; Story 12.2 un-skips it last, after clearing the baseline. Do NOT clear skips in this story.
- **Repo guard already exists:** `scripts/check-no-skipped-tests.sh` independently enforces no skips — the scanner spec mirrors that rule as an executable unit test so the contract lives inside the suite too.
- **Testing standard:** place the scanner where it can read all four project trees (repo-root-relative). Keep file reads synchronous and bounded; do not scan `node_modules` or `dist`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Add: one scanner spec (location chosen so it reaches all four `apps/*` trees from the repo root).
- No source change to production code — this story adds a test-only contract.
- No conflict: additive; does not modify any existing spec's skip markers (that is Story 12.2).
